description: Track mileage across your running shoes and get a replacement alert when a pair passes 500 km.

faqs.a: Add a shoe, then log each run with its date and distance. Totals build up automatically and are saved in your browser.
faqs.q: How do I track a shoe?

faqs.a: Around 500–800 km for most trainers. This tool warns you at 500 km so you can start planning a replacement.
faqs.q: When should running shoes be replaced?

faqs.a: Yes — all data is stored in your browser's localStorage and never leaves your device.

howto: Add each pair of running shoes by name.
Log every run: pick the shoe, date, and distance in km.
Watch per-shoe totals grow in the mileage table.
Replace any shoe flagged past the 500 km warning.
title: Running Shoe Mileage Tracker
